findings.what: Length limits use String.length (UTF-16 code units) rather than characters; emoji/astral chars count double, so valid names/messages near the limit are rejected.
Relies on experimental synchronous node:sqlite (Node>=22.5) writing to cwd/data/app.db inside a server action; fails on read-only/serverless hosts and the constraint is undocumented.
Single role=status live region used for both success and save-failure messages; errors are announced politely only and distinguished just by colour.
Paragraph text used as React key; duplicate config paragraphs would collide.
